title: Repair the Stack
prompt: The class Stack below has THREE bugs: pop on empty must raise IndexError (it returns None), peek must not remove the item (it does), and size must reflect the count (it miscounts). Fix the class so all behaviors hold. Do not rename anything.

tests.name: pop empty raises IndexError
tests.code:
s = Stack()
try:
    s.pop()
    failed = False
except IndexError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: Guard the empty case: raise IndexError, never return None.

tests.name: peek does not remove
tests.code:
s = Stack()
s.push('x')
assert s.peek() == 'x'
assert s.size() == 1
tests.hint: peek reads the last item without popping.

tests.name: size is accurate
tests.code:
s = Stack()
s.push(1); s.push(2); s.pop()
assert s.size() == 1

tests.name: full lifecycle
tests.code:
s = Stack()
s.push('a'); s.push('b')
assert s.pop() == 'b' and s.peek() == 'a' and s.size() == 1
tests.hint: LIFO order preserved end to end.
